question: Rishu went 5 km towards the west from her house. From here, she turned left and covered a distance of 4 km. She took a left turn again and covered a distance of 5 km. She finally turned right and travelled 3 km and stopped. What is the shortest distance between the point where she stopped and her house? (All turns are 90° turns only)
solution:
**Explanation:**

 
• Rishu went 5 km towards the west from her house.
 
• From here, she turned left and covered a distance of 4 km.
 
• She took a left turn again and covered a distance of 5 km.
 
• She finally turned right and travelled 3 km and stopped

. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ead93fb40d3c7032f27a3490298e448e7108d752fc691edd6ef716730e08e4c3.png] 

 
• So the shortest distance = 4 + 3 = 7 km

Hence, **7 km **is the correct answer.
